units: background component; draws are not biological replicates

bootstrap.scope: within-seed equal-component bootstrap; pooled first averages seeds within component; pooled run fields list all contributing runs and do not represent one run; KVP40 is a separate application background and not a 45th component

hamming_pairing: per background/seed/mask/stratum, independently sample n=min(n_left,n_right) draws within each side using stable_seed(left_run,right_run,background,mask,stratum,seed,"left"/"right"); equal attempt budget; the original overall comparison keeps all draws under common uniform seeds
distance: background-alignment-conditioned nearest-training distance: stable_alignment (BLOSUM62, open gap -10, extend gap -0.5, max_optimal from config, both-direction stable coverage >= 0.80); candidate edits are substituted on the fixed background mapping and scored against all qualified training references; minimum over references; uncovered positions and ambiguity are reported separately
distance_limitations: The mapping is fixed from the background sequence; candidate edits do not change the alignment. This is not a per-candidate realignment distance.
edit_mismatch_fraction: fraction of the candidate domain edits at which the candidate differs from the nearest aligned training reference at those mapped positions; it is not an edit-site nearest-neighbour search
background_nearest_identity_role: background property only; not used as a candidate distance
